metadata.title: How it works - prophetica
metadata.description: The full player flow from registration to settlement: four entry steps, matching, market weights, Oracle settlement, and dispute windows.

hero.headline: From registration to settlement in five minutes.
hero.tagline: Use in-app points to take a view on unrevealed event outcomes. Your orders join an order book against other players while the system handles matching, settlement, and records.

principles.heading: Three design principles
principles.intro: Understand points, the order book, and event records first; market prices will then feel more intuitive.

points.title: In-app points.
points.body: Points added to your account are used for in-app markets, locked balances, and settlement display.

orderbook.title: Order book matching.
orderbook.body: The system matches player orders by price priority, then time priority, and records every trade.

events.title: Event records.
events.body: Payments, matching, settlement, and decisions are written to an event stream so support and engineering can trace them.

startSteps.heading: Four entry steps
startSteps.intro: The first two steps are account safety and protection settings. The third and fourth are gameplay related.

register.title: Register an account
register.body: Email + mobile OTP + birthday (>=18). Complete basic Tier 1 verification in under 10 seconds without uploading document images.

rg.title: Set your limits
rg.body: A monthly top-up limit is a required protection line (choose TWD 1k / 5k / 30k / 100k). You can also add wager limits, loss limits, and cooldown triggers.

topup.title: Add points
topup.body: Use the licensed payment rails for your jurisdiction. Points usually arrive within 5 minutes. 1 point = TWD 1 for internal accounting.

trade.title: Browse markets and place orders
trade.body: Choose a market you understand, buy one YES or NO share, and wait for settlement. Each share settles to 100 points on a win or 0 points on a loss.

matching.headline: Every matchup is player versus player.
matching.lead: When you buy one YES share, the system searches the order book for a matching counterparty and matches by price priority, then time priority.

platformTakes.title: Fees charged on both sides
platformTakes.body: Fees are based on trading volume and are unrelated to whether you win or lose. We want active markets, not one-sided losses.

platformDoesNot.title: The gap between player wins and losses
platformDoesNot.body: Trades and settlement are determined by orders, positions, and Oracle decisions. The system only presents the result and record.

matching.cta: See a real order book example

pricing.heading: Prices are shown as market weights
pricing.intro: Each YES / NO quote falls between 1 and 99. The higher the number, the more the market leans toward that result. A YES weight of 38 can be read as the market currently leaning about 38% toward YES. Actual cost and settlement are still calculated in points.
pricing.exampleHeading: Reading one trade at YES weight 38
pricing.exampleIntro: Assume "Taiwan reaches the WBSC semifinals" currently has YES weight 38. You buy 100 YES shares:

winYes.label: Settles YES
winYes.note: 100 shares settle to 100 points, minus the 38-point cost

loseNo.label: Settles NO
loseNo.note: Each share credits 0 points, so the full cost is lost

pricing.exit: Want to exit early? You can post a sell order in the order book. The fill price is determined by the market weight at that time.

settlement.heading: Settlement comes from Oracle
settlement.intro: When each market is listed, the platform specifies a clear decision source (Oracle). After close, the Oracle result determines YES or NO and settlement credits player wallets automatically.

transparent.title: Decision sources are public
transparent.body: Each market page lists its oracle source clearly, such as a weather agency, FOMC announcement, or election commission. There is no "we think" decision.

appealWindow.title: 24-hour dispute window
appealWindow.body: You can open a dispute ticket within 24 hours after settlement. Every dispute receives a status response; multi-user or high-value cases escalate to Compliance T3.

stateMachine.title: Settlement state machine
stateMachine.body: PENDING -> SETTLING -> SETTLED or CANCELLED. Every transition is written to the event stream and can be reviewed in your account records.

autoPayout.title: Positions convert automatically
autoPayout.body: At settlement, the system converts positions into points without any manual action. You can review the credited result in Portfolio.

compliance.headline: Complete account setup before using markets.
compliance.body: People under 18 may not participate. Monthly top-up limits, cooldowns, and account-closure tools help players control their play rhythm.

closing.headline: Start with registration and browse your first market within 10 minutes.
closing.tagline: Basic verification takes 10 seconds, limit setup takes about one minute, and top-ups usually arrive within five minutes.

metadata.title: Limits - prophetica
metadata.description: Limit settings, cooldowns, account closure, and help resources.

hero.headline: Your rhythm stays in your hands.
hero.tagline: prophetica is entertainment, not a financial product. We provide tools so you can adjust, pause, or leave at any time, with independent help resources when you need them.

limits.title: Top-up limits
limits.body: A monthly top-up limit is the required protection line set during prophetica registration. Lowering it takes effect immediately; raising it requires a 24-hour cooldown.

cooldown.title: Cooldown
cooldown.body: Pause play for a short period. During the pause, the account cannot sign in, top up, or trade; it restores automatically when the period ends.

selfExclusion.title: Close account
selfExclusion.body: Stop using the service for the medium term, long term, or permanently. Permanent closure cannot be reversed, so decide carefully.

resources.title: Help resources
resources.body: Addiction counseling, mental health hotlines, and international support groups. Free 24-hour help independent of prophetica.

stubPage.tagline: This page is being prepared and will launch in a future release. Thank you for your patience.

hero.headline: Prediction is a contest of perspective.
hero.tagline: Use in-app points to forecast unrevealed event outcomes and compare your judgment with players around the world.

neutral.headline: Fair matching. Clear settlement.
neutral.tagline: prophetica only provides matching and settlement. It does not hold contract positions or act as a market maker. Every market is a player-versus-player contest of judgment.

points.headline: In-app points, entertainment only.
points.tagline: Points added to your account are shown as balance, locked amount, and settlement records inside the app.

responsibleGaming.headline: Set your limit before you play.
responsibleGaming.tagline: Every account must complete limit settings. We provide cooldowns, account closure, and help resources, with zero tolerance for underage participation.

start.headline: Verify, set limits, browse markets.
start.tagline: Identity verification keeps play fair and compliant, limits protect your entertainment rhythm, and the market list is your arena.

offline.headline: Cannot connect to Prophetica
offline.body: Check Wi-Fi or mobile data, then retry below. To avoid showing stale data, we do not cache balances or order screens while offline.
